verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 55.37
verses.english: Linked Discourses 55.37

verses.pali: 4. Puññābhisandavagga
verses.english: 4. Overflowing Merit

verses.pali: Mahānāmasutta
verses.english: With Mahānāma

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṁ nigrodhārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Sakyans, near Kapilavatthu in the Banyan Tree Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Mahānāma the Sakyan went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, upāsako hotī”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, how is a lay follower defined?”

verses.pali: “Yato kho, mahānāma, buddhaṁ saraṇaṁ gato hoti, dhammaṁ saraṇaṁ gato hoti, saṅghaṁ saraṇaṁ gato hoti—
verses.english: “Mahānāma, when you’ve gone for refuge to the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha,

verses.pali: ettāvatā kho, mahānāma, upāsako hotī”ti.
verses.english: you’re considered to be a lay follower.”

verses.pali: “Kittāvatā pana, bhante, upāsako sīlasampanno hotī”ti?
verses.english: “But how is an ethical lay follower defined?”

verses.pali: “Yato kho, mahānāma, upāsako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti—
verses.english: “When a lay follower doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants,

verses.pali: ettāvatā kho, mahānāma, upāsako sīlasampanno hotī”ti.
verses.english: they’re considered to be an ethical lay follower.”

verses.pali: “Kittāvatā pana, bhante, upāsako saddhāsampanno hotī”ti?
verses.english: “But how is a faithful lay follower defined?”

verses.pali: “Idha, mahānāma, upāsako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṁ—
verses.english: “It’s when a lay follower has faith in the Realized One’s awakening:

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
verses.english: ‘That Blessed One is perfected, a fully awakened Buddha, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, holy, knower of the world, supreme guide for those fit for training, teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.’

verses.pali: Ettāvatā kho, mahānāma, upāsako saddhāsampanno hotī”ti.
verses.english: Then they’re considered to be a faithful lay follower.”

verses.pali: “Kittāvatā pana, bhante, upāsako cāgasampanno hotī”ti?
verses.english: “But how is a generous lay follower defined?”

verses.pali: “Idha, mahānāma, upāsako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṁvibhāgarato—
verses.english: “It’s when a lay follower lives at home rid of the stain of stinginess, freely generous, open-handed, loving to let go, committed to charity, loving to give and to share.

verses.pali: ettāvatā kho, mahānāma, upāsako cāgasampanno hotī”ti.
verses.english: Then they’re considered to be a generous lay follower.”

verses.pali: “Kittāvatā pana, bhante, upāsako paññāsampanno hotī”ti?
verses.english: “But how is a wise lay follower defined?”

verses.pali: “Idha, mahānāma, upāsako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā—
verses.english: “It’s when a lay follower is wise. They have the wisdom of arising and passing away which is noble, penetrative, and leads to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: ettāvatā kho, mahānāma, upāsako paññāsampanno hotī”ti.
verses.english: Then they’re considered to be a wise lay follower.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
